report.success_criterion: The test suite at the buggy commit exhibits failures or warnings related to dtype mismatches and Dask 'numpy.copyto' warnings. Specifically: (1) test_zscore_constant_input_2d fails xp_assert_equal(z, xp.full(y.shape, xp.asarray(xp.nan))) due to xp.full receiving an array instead of scalar fill_value; (2) test_ttest_ind_axis_size_zero fails due to dtype mismatch when b is not converted to a.dtype before NaN construction; (3) test_2d_size_zero_with_axis and test_gh21610 emit suppressed Dask FutureWarnings about 'numpy.copyto' that would be visible without the filter marks (indicating the underlying issue). Once the fix is applied (replacing xp.asarray(xp.nan) with xp.nan, updating _get_nan signature, and casting b to a.dtype), all tests pass and Dask warnings are eliminated.
